capabilities: Display current weather for a chosen city in a panel
Fetch weather data from WeatherAPI.com using a personal API key
Refresh the weather feed on a minimum 30-minute interval
Style or hide display elements with CSS classes and snippets
Open the weather view from a Tenki: Open command
extras: Includes a network usage disclosure per Obsidian developer policy and a Buy Me a Coffee donation link.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see current weather inside the app.

relations.evidence: This plugin retrieves information from the internet to get the weather data

summary: Weather display panel that shows current conditions for a chosen city using data from WeatherAPI.com.
